# Rachel Amzaleg — Practical System QA and AI-Assisted Quality

> Professional portfolio and practical QA articles by Rachel Amzaleg, an Israel-based senior system QA and quality engineering professional.

Rachel's work covers complex system and integration testing, cybersecurity and data security, API and database testing, Windows and Linux environments, risk-based quality engineering, and evidence-led technical investigation. The site also documents how AI assistants can support QA workflows while test results and decisions remain independently verified.

## Profile and guide indexes

- [Professional portfolio (English)](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/): About the author, technical focus and contact links.
- [פרופיל ומדריכים (עברית)](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/he/): Hebrew home page.
- [English QA guide library](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/field-notes/): Technical guides and search.
- [ספריית מדריכי QA בעברית](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/he/field-notes/): Hebrew guide index.

## Selected technical articles

- [AI-Assisted QA: A Practical Workflow](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/ai-qa-workflow/): Understand changes, plan risk-based tests, collect evidence and report verified findings.
- [QA Evidence and Approval Checkpoints](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/ai-qa-checkpoints/): Verification and decision checkpoints in AI-assisted QA.
- [From QA Setup to a Verified Claude Runbook](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/claude-runbooks/): Reuse only validated environment setup instructions.
- [Turn Repeated QA Work into a Claude Skill](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/claude-reuse/): Document a proven reusable process.
- [Browser Automation and AI Token Efficiency](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/browser-automation/): Practical browser automation and responsible use of AI context.
- [Build a QA Improvement Loop](https://rachelamzaleg.github.io/ai-qa-improvement/): Make corrections and lessons useful in future testing.
